meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目配置语言服务器，让代码诊断和跳转生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会识别项目用的是哪种语言,安装配套的语言服务器,需要时写好配置文件;再运行一次真实诊断检查,确认报错提示、跳转定义、查找引用等功能可用。覆盖 TypeScript、Python、Go 等约 20 种语言。
howto.when: 当你说要配置 LSP、安装语言服务器,或修复“未安装/未配置语言服务器”的报错时触发;同类需求(选择服务器、写配置文件等)也会接管。

say.text: 帮我给这个 Python 项目配置 LSP。
say.note: Claude 会先识别语言,再走安装—配置—验证流程。

say.text: 我收到“未安装语言服务器”的报错,帮我处理。
say.note: 按对应的语言参考装好服务器并重新验证。

say.text: Python 语言服务器选 basedpyright 还是 ruff?
say.note: 会对比两者特点,并把所选服务器写进配置文件。

howto.what_en: Claude detects the project language, installs the matching language server, writes config when required, and verifies with a real diagnostics roundtrip (errors, go-to-def, references, rename). Covers ~20 languages: TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure LSP, install a language server, or fix “no LSP server configured/not installed” errors; also for choosing between servers or editing lsp config files.

say_en.text: Set up LSP for this Python project.
say_en.note: Detects Python, installs the server, then verifies.

say_en.text: I got “server not installed” — please fix it.
say_en.note: Installs per the language reference and re-runs verification.

say_en.text: Should I use basedpyright or ruff here?
say_en.note: Compares options and writes the chosen server into config.
